[A] Two Piles
Nika has two piles with $x$ and $y$ stones. She wonders whether the piles have equal size.

### Input

The only line contains two integers $x$ and $y$ ($0 \le x, y \le 1000$).

### Output

Print `YES` if $x = y$, otherwise print `NO`.

=====

[B] Hidden Number
The jury has chosen a hidden integer $x$ ($1 \le x \le 10^6$). Guess it.

### Interaction

You may ask at most $25$ queries of the form "? $y$". The jury answers "<" if $x < y$ and ">=" otherwise. When you know $x$, print "! $x$".
